name: @pipeworx/mcp-fr-legifrance

tools.name: fr_legifrance_search
tools.description: Full-text search across French legal sources the Légifrance API serves beyond codes and Cour de cassation case law: the Journal officiel (fond JORF), collective-bargaining agreements (KALI), Conseil d'État / administrative case law (CETAT, the JADE dataset), Constitutional Council decisions (CONSTIT), circulaires (CIRC), company-level agreements (ACCO) and CNIL decisions (CNIL). One fond per call. For consolidated codes/LODA use @pipeworx/france-legi; for Cour de cassation judicial case law use @pipeworx/fr-judilibre.

query.description: Full-text search terms, e.g. "licenciement économique" or "convention collective métallurgie".

date_start.description: Decision date range start, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Only applied for fond CETAT/CONSTIT.

date_end.description: Decision date range end, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Only applied for fond CETAT/CONSTIT.

_apiKey.description: PISTE OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret" for an application subscribed to the "Légifrance Beta" API product. Different from fr-judilibre's KeyId.

tools.name: fr_legifrance_text
tools.description: Read one full text by id from fr_legifrance_search's results: a JORFTEXT (Journal officiel), KALITEXT/KALIARTI/KALICONT (collective agreement text/article/container), CETATEXT (Conseil d'État decision), CONSTEXT (Constitutional Council decision), CNILTEXT or ACCOTEXT id. For a circulaire (which has no prefixed id, just a number), pass fond:"CIRC". Refuses a JURITEXT id (Cour de cassation) and a LEGITEXT/LEGIARTI id (codes/LODA), naming the sibling pack that serves those.

id.description: The text id, from a fr_legifrance_search result, or a bare circulaire number.

fond.description: Only needed to read a circulaire by its bare numeric id, which has no recognisable prefix.

_apiKey.description: PISTE OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret" for an application subscribed to the "Légifrance Beta" API product. Different from fr-judilibre's KeyId.

tools.name: fr_legifrance_journal_officiel_recent
tools.description: List the most recently published issues of the Journal officiel de la République française, each with its id, publication date, JO number and the texts it contains. A text id inside an issue can be read with fr_legifrance_text.

n.description: Number of recent issues to return, 1-30 (default 5).

_apiKey.description: PISTE OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret" for an application subscribed to the "Légifrance Beta" API product. Different from fr-judilibre's KeyId.

tools.name: fr_legifrance_convention_collective
tools.description: Resolve a collective-bargaining agreement by its IDCC number (e.g. "1261") to its title, scope and the KALITEXT ids of its base texts — the entry point for KALI when you have an IDCC rather than a raw text id. Read a returned base_text_id with fr_legifrance_text; find amendments by keyword with fr_legifrance_search(fond:"KALI").

idcc.description: The convention's IDCC identification number, e.g. "1261".

_apiKey.description: PISTE OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret" for an application subscribed to the "Légifrance Beta" API product. Different from fr-judilibre's KeyId.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fr-legifrance forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fr-legifrance pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
